words.row_comment: Algorithm enable flags word 7 (EEPROM 0x198; e2m 106B +10): the engine protection enables of channels 0-3 - coolant level 0x1-0x8 / coolant temperature 0x10-0x80 / intake manifold temperature 0x100-0x800 / oil pressure 0x1000-0x8000, four bits per channel: fueling limiting / rpm limiting / shutdown / restart (Calterm EPCV / EPCQ / EPIM / EPO2 + FLEN / RPEN / SOEN / RYEN; channel n = config record 0x807032 + 36 x n). The protection loops read them as table bit 0x70 + 4 x channel + k from word 0 (0x803c94): k 0 the fault derate fuel limit loop cm550_FUN_00019702, k 1 cm550_calculateFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit, k 2 the shutdown loop processDiagnosticLimitStatus, k 2 and k 3 the restart checks cm550_diagnosticProtectionEvaluator / cm550_protectionState1DiagnosticValidator. One direct reader: cm550_FUN_00019702 tests 0x1000 at 0x1983e for the oil pressure start-up inhibit. No store in the dumped ROM. 0xffff in the EEPROM and RAM dumps (all four channels fully enabled). CM848 twin algorithm_enable_flags_7_cal (0x3fd5aa) has the same 16 e2m records but stays a plain word (nothing reads it there). (no row before; PR #53 round 92)
words.differences_from_cm848: No bit differs: CM848's word 7 (0x3fd5aa) has the same 16 e2m records at the same masks (Coolant_Level / Coolant_Temperature / IMT / Oil_Pressure x Fueling_Limiting / RPM_Limiting / Shutdown / Restart). But CM848 keeps it a plain word (its engine protection loops start at table bit 128 so nothing reads it) and has no algorithm_enable_flags_7_t, so there is no CM848 type to share: the type is CM550's own, with field names spelled from CM848's e2m record names. In CM550 the loops start at table bit 112 and channels 0-3 read all 16 bits.
words.code_tests: Direct: 0x1983e move.w (0x803ca2).l,d0 + andi.w #0x1000 + beq (cm550_FUN_00019702 @ 0x19702) = bit 12. Indexed from word 0 (movea.l #0x803c94,a0 then move.w (0,a0,dn.w*2): word index = bit / 16, mask = 1 shifted left by bit mod 16): table bit 0x70 + 4 x channel + k, channels 0-3 = this word. k 0 cm550_FUN_00019702 (moveq #0x70 at 0x19718); k 1 cm550_calculateFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit (moveq #0x71 at 0x18e22); k 2 processDiagnosticLimitStatus (moveq #0x72 at 0x1902a); k 2 and k 3 of the recorded shutdown channel in cm550_diagnosticProtectionEvaluator (addi.w #0x70 at 0x18b64, then +2 / +3) and cm550_protectionState1DiagnosticValidator (moveq #0x70 at 0x18cf8). What the bits do there: k 0 / k 1 - the loop computes the channel's fueling / rpm severity only while the bit or the channel's history-only bit (table bit 0x1a0 + channel = word 26) is set; k 2 - the channel's shutdown timers run only while set (clear zeroes them); k 3 - with k 2 set and the channel recorded as the shutdown channel, cm550_diagnosticProtectionEvaluator examines it before cranking once the shutdown count has reached its maximum (it skips channel 3) and cm550_protectionState1DiagnosticValidator updates its restart severity indexes. Channel identity from the extended RAM dump: each state record (0x80d0dc + 46 x channel) starts with the channel's input pointer - channel 0 0x8091e6 (the coolant level low switch input) / 1 0x80a336 (e2m ADCLTPFT filtered coolant temperature) / 2 0x80a26a (the intake manifold temperature pre-processed for engine protection) / 3 0x80a30a (ADOLPRFT filtered oil pressure). .cpp: 1 plain test, no value-flow form.
words.writes: none: the one absolute reference is the move.w read at 0x1983e, the indexed accesses are move.w reads, and nothing references the odd byte 0x803ca3. Only the generic EEPROM mirror writers can change it.

proposal.notes:
METHOD. Every absolute-long reference to 0x803ca2-0x803cb1 in J90350.00.rom.bin was found and decoded (scratch direct_tests.py): 29 move.w (abs).l,d0 reads, each followed by andi.w / andi.l with a single-bit mask and a branch, plus one address load (move.l #0x803cae,(0x80054c).l at 0x15dd2). No store, no btst, no byte access, no reference to an odd address and none to word 10 (0x803ca8). The indexed accesses use word 0 as their base; I hand-decoded two of them (0x19734-0x19756 and 0x208ce-0x208fc: moveq / addi the bit number, divide or mask by 16, lsl a 1, asr.l #4, move.w (0,a0,dn.w*2)) so table bit i = word i / 16, mask 1 shifted left by i mod 16, and I read the loop constants in the machine code (moveq #0x70 / #0x71 / #0x72, addi.l #0xd0). llvm-objdump-18 and llvm-mc-18 drop many m68k opcodes, so the instruction addresses come from the byte scan and the behaviour from the committed .cpp. The nine protection channels are identified three ways that agree: the 106B records, the e2m names of each channel's own records (configs 0x807032 + 36n, states 0x80d0dc + 46n, severities 0x8057c0 + 30n) and the input pointer at the start of each state record in the extended RAM dump (read at file offset address - 0x809242, the dump being 0x80 short). Dump values: EEPROM 0x198-0x1a7 equals RAM 0x803ca2-0x803cb1 (w7 0xffff, w8 0, w9 0, w10 0, w11 0x000b, w12 0xbb87, w13 0, w14 0).

OLD NAMES AGAINST THE E2M WORD NUMBER. Only calibration_feature_enable_flags_word_9 (0x803cac) is misnumbered: (0x803cac - 0x803c94) / 2 = 12 and its records say WORD C. diagnostic_subsystem_enable_flags (word 11) is a wrong domain: the word enables the datalink protocols. switch_override_configuration (word 13) is right in substance. The e2m writes the word number in hex for word 12 (C) and in decimal for words 13 / 14 ('WORD 13 BIT 9', 'WORD 14 BIT 1'); both fit offset = 2 + 2 x n.

TYPES. Word 11 takes CM848's algorithm_enable_flags_11_t (the only shared type of the batch; check_shared_r92.py prints 'names equal' for it). Words 7 / 8 / 12 / 13 / 14 are cm550_ bitfields: each has direct single-bit tests and no store. Word 9 stays a plain word: nothing reads it by its own address (CM848's rule for its words 7 / 8 / 26), so its fields are for the row comment only.
- Word 7 is the one judgment call on the type: all 16 bits equal CM848's e2m records for its word 7, but CM848 has no algorithm_enable_flags_7_t (a plain word with no reader), so there is nothing to share and I used cm550_algorithm_enable_flags_7_t. If you would rather have one shared type, rename it algorithm_enable_flags_7_t and add the same rows to CM848 (its row can be retyped with no render change, since nothing reads it); the field names already follow CM848's e2m record names.

NAMING CHOICES TO REVIEW.
- Engine protection bits: CHANNEL_fueling_limiting_enable / _rpm_limiting_enable / _shutdown_enable / _restart_enable, after CM848's e2m record names (Coolant_Level_Fueling_Limiting_Enable ... Coolant_Level_Restart_Enable) and algorithm_enable_flags_2_t.engine_protection_restart_enable. The restart bit does not allow a restart: with the shutdown bit it lets the restart checks shut the engine down again ('PREVENTS RESTART AT POWERUP WHEN SHUTDN CNT > MAX SHUTDN CNT'). CHANNEL_restart_limitation_enable would say that more plainly (the e2m and CM848 both call the algorithm the restart limitation); I kept CM848's wording so the twins match. Channel names are the ones W4 used for word 26 (the same nine channels).
- Word 12 bits 8 / 9 take CM848's field names, which describe CM848's detectors; J90350.00 has no reader for them in the dump, only the same VSMVEN / VSSTEN records.
- Word 12 bit 5 keeps CM848's reverse_electronic_smart_power_enable (label Reverse_ESP_Enable); CM550's own text and code say ESP launch application (tau source state 1 of NORMAL / LAUNCH / STEEP).
- Word 12 bit 1 is overspeed_fuel_shutoff_enable in both firmwares (the CM848 rename), parallel to W1's word 0 bit 6 engine_retarder_fuel_shutoff_enable: the two bits gate the same fuel shutoff decision at 0x1ca54.
- Word 13 bit 0 has no 106B record. I named it key_switch_override_enable because the code proves it: the byte mask [1] applies to all eight bits of status byte 0, and bit 0 of that byte is the key switch (000E DSKYSWSS; the engine state and power-down code read it as the key). If a bit needs its own 106B record to be named, make it reserved_bit_0 and keep this as the guess.
- Words 13 / 14: a bit is named for a function when its own 106B record names that function (by text or by a mnemonic that the 000E / 12A8 / 12FC / 1234 records of the same logical switch spell out) or when the code proves it. Where the 106B record gives only a switch number, the name is switch_N_override_enable with the e2m's switch number (word 14 bits 0 / 10 / 12 / 15) and the other blocks' aliases are guesses in the comment. Word 14 bit 11 has two complete alias sets (AC high pressure switch and throttle interlock), so it is switch_28_override_enable.
- Accelerator interlock: the J1939 descriptor table (ROM 0x20108 entry 1 = JCTHILMU, the multiplexed throttle interlock value) drives logical switch 9, so word 13 bit 9 is the accelerator interlock override. The e2m's DSTHILUO (group MUX_PARA) puts it at word 14 bit 11; that group's other 106B record MXLPANEA is also off by one word against the code (W4).
- Word 14 bit 9 has a 76-character name, switched_throttle_control_or_all_speed_governor_droop_switch_override_enable, because the e2m's 'STCG ASG DROOP SWITCH' is one switch with two roles (word 27 bit 3 picks the switched throttle control governor or the all speed governor droop). The shorter switched_throttle_control_governor_droop_switch_override_enable drops the all speed governor half.

SIBLING CONSISTENCY (please reconcile).
- W3's word 16 uses cruise_control_resume_switch_override_enable and cruise_control_set_switch_override_enable for the DECODED cruise status bits (0x80bcd4). Word 13 bits 1 / 2 are the raw switches that the e2m gives exactly those names (DSCRRUUO / DSCRSEUO). Two structs may share a field name, but the two layers should not: I suggest renaming W3's (for example cruise_control_resume_status_override_enable).
- W3 writes air_conditioner_ (word 15 bit 11, word 17 bit 8). I used air_conditioning_, as CM848 (air_conditioning_switch, fan_air_conditioning_pressure_enable), W1 and W4 do.
- Engine brake: W1 / W4 say engine_retarder_ for EB records, W3 says engine_brake_relay_. For the switch I used engine_brake_select_1_ because CM848's own switch record is Engine_Brake_Select_1 (and its switch_input_state_t has engine_brake_driver_1_feedback).
- The row comments call word 0 'word 0 (0x803c94)' because W1 renames it; put the final row name in if you prefer.

E2M TEXT CAVEATS. v64t6_s cuts descriptions at about 50 characters. Completions in parentheses come from longer copies of the same record in other e2m files (42t9_rls, the CHR files) for word 7, EPFT*, EPOSFSO, SPRVEN, PTBRODEN / PTCHODEN (their bit letters B / C), LSCIIHEN (bit 14) and the DS..UO switch records; for EPWF / EPBS / EPFP / EPAA no longer copy exists (33 files, all cut) and the completion comes from the record's SOEN sibling. Texts that contradict their own record: EPBSFLEN (engine sync text on the boost record), DSPRBRUO (manual fan text on the parking brake record), DSAKONUO (the status record's text), EPCQRPEN 'BIT 5 OF 5-15', EPFTSOEN 'BIT 14 OF 0-14'. One counter-witness on the parking brake (word 14 bit 7, logical switch 23): block 12FC lists its default DSDFPRBR at mask 0x80000 (logical switch 19, next to the remote throttle switch) and only 'SWITCH 24' at bit 23, against three records at 23 (000E value DSPRBRUC, 12A8 +17 DSPZPRBR, 1234 DSPRBRIV) and the 106B mnemonic. Quotes are comma-stripped for the CSV. EDF is spelled out by the e2m's own group record 12C (ENDTFL07 'ENGINE DATA FILES ENABLE AND POWER-DOWNS'), ESP by group 43 (ESP_08 'ELECTRONIC SMART POWER GROUP'), PTP by group PTP_07, STCG by STCGASDS.

'NO READER' always means none in the dumped 256 KB (109 call targets above 0x40000 are not dumped). Word 12 has bits 7 / 8 / 9 / 11 / 12 / 13 / 15 set in the calibration with no reader in the dump.

Value-flow forms that may print as pieces once typed: word 8 2 of 2 tests; word 11 3 CONCAT22 forms; word 12 5 assigned / returned values + 1 CONCAT22; word 13 2 + 1 CONCAT22; word 14 1 of 1. verdict.overall:
No bit position, mask, address, EEPROM offset or dump value in W2 moves, no word is written, and nothing is refuted: 106 CONFIRMED, 14 AMENDED. One amendment changes a field name (word 12 bit 9), one carries a row comment fix plus the type name judgment the proposer flagged (word 7), the other twelve are comment fixes (eight of them the same count in word 9's documentation-only bits).

How it was checked (from scratch; scripts in /home/linux/.claude/jobs/374b0424/tmp/w15/r92/scratch/W2/skeptic/): my own CPU32 disassembler (m68k.py; llvm-mc-18 mis-decodes andi / tst here), a scan of the ROM for every 32-bit operand in the block at any byte offset (absrefs.py), the raw v64t6_s records with their masks (raw106b.py, blockmasks.py), all 36 ISB and 23 CHR e2m files (survey.py, countfiles.py), both dumps at word width (dumps.py), CM848's CSVs, e2m and RAM dump. The verdict list was built and checked by build_verdict_W2.py (120 elements, each quoted 'replace' string occurs exactly once in the proposal text it amends); a copy is in verdict_W2.json in that folder.

What holds: 30 references to 0x803ca2-0x803cb1, all at even offsets: 29 x move.w (abs).l,d0 followed by andi.w / andi.l with one bit, and the one address load at 0x15dd2. No reference to words 9 / 10, to an odd address, to the EEPROM form 0x01000198-0x010001a7, or off the mirror base; no other register is loaded with a block address. All 15 indexed sites are movea.l #0x803c94,a0 + move.w (0,a0,dn.w*2) reads with word = bit / 16 and mask = 1 shifted left by bit mod 16. Dumps: 0xffff / 0 / 0 / 0x000b / 0xbb87 / 0 / 0, EEPROM = RAM. Two things back the nine protection channels beyond what the proposal cites: the input pointers are set by ROM code (vp44_engineProtectionSystemInit 0x1873e), not only seen in the dump, and e2m 10B3 +0 EPSOAE lists 'C. LEV. = 0, C. TEMP. = 1, IMT = 2, OIL PRESS. = 3'. The 32 switch bits follow from the sampler's own byte masks and agree across five e2m blocks (106B, 000E, 12A8, 12FC, 1234) and the J1939 descriptor table at ROM 0x20108.

The amendments: (1) word 12 bit 9: 'zero under load' is CM848's code wording; CM550 has only VSSTEN 'lost while stopped' and no reader, so the name becomes vehicle_speed_sensor_lost_while_stopped_detection_enable (bit 8 may take the parallel 'lost_while_moving_detection' name; its present name is not wrong). (2) word 7: the direct test is the start-up fueling derate (EPFLSRTM = CM848 Fueling_Startup_Derate_Time), not an inhibit; and, separately, the type can be the unprefixed algorithm_enable_flags_7_t because no bit differs from CM848. (3) word 7 bit 14: the evaluator skips channel 3. (4) counts: EPOE* / EPOS* are in 18 files not 20 (word 9 bits 4-11), JCRWDXEN in 13 not 14 (word 11 bit 4), the OBD fault handler mask 0x400 in 28 not 26 (word 12 bit 10), LSCIIHEN '- BIT 14' in 9 not 13 (word 12 bit 14).

Corrections to the notes, outside the elements: EPWF / EPBS / EPFP / EPAA are in 27 files, not 33. The read at 0x1cd96 is followed by sne d0, not a branch. AD25OD (the word 20 aside; the test at 0x20fd8 is real, andi.w #0x200) is in 5 other files, not six. The notes count 15 indexed sites but describe only the protection loops and cm550_FUN_00020890; the fifteenth, at 0x206e6, is cm550_FUN_000206a8, called five times from cm550_FUN_00021070 with switches 54 / 54 / 33 / 32 / 54, so it reaches words 15 / 16 only and nothing in this batch.
